current_activity: landing at Beach Red with the 35th RCT
notes: The 35th Regimental Combat Team landed at Beach Red on 17 December 1942 (Miller, ch. IX; Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9). The 3rd Battalion is treated as landing with that RCT. Confidence 0.7, matching regiment claim C12815.

location_qualifier: approaching Hills 43 and 44 from the south
current_activity: beginning the envelopment of the Sea Horse from south of Hill 27
notes: Miller, ch. XII: Lt. Col. William J. Mullen, Jr.'s 3rd Battalion left its assembly area at 0300 on 10 January and attacked toward the Sea Horse (Hills 43 and 44) at H-Hour 0635. Matches regiment claim C12922. Confidence 0.5: Hough, Ludwig and Shaw mention the Sea Horse without a calendar day for this envelopment.

current_activity: driving the Japanese off Hill 43 and occupying Hill 44
notes: Miller, ch. XII: at dawn on 11 January the 3rd Battalion resumed the attack; it drove the Japanese off Hill 43 and by 1831 had advanced to Hill 44. By nightfall L Company held Hill 44, I Company the neck, and K Company Hill 43. Matches regiment claim C12923. Confidence 0.5: one official family.
